81904.subject: Keep your Copilot history: Sign in by December 31, 2026
81904.body:

=======================================

We’ve moved to an updated experience that brings Copilot together in one simple, cohesive app. Learn about the updates. 

To keep your existing Copilot history, open the updated experience and sign in by December 31, 2026. Your chats, images, and other eligible content you’ve created with Copilot will move with you to the updated experience.
